response.explanation: The domain entity Subscription imports SystemClock from the outbound adapter layer (src/domain/subscription.ts:1). It creates its own instance in a private field (line 4) and calls clock.now() inside isActive() (line 9). This means the domain core depends directly on a concrete infrastructure class rather than on a port it owns. That reverses the dependency direction that FF-P06 enforces, and it makes isActive() depend on wall-clock time in a way tests cannot easily control. The graph shows the same thing: one FLOWS_TO edge from Subscription to SystemClock and one CALLS edge to SystemClock.now. However, ADR-0002 (Status: Accepted) explicitly allows the domain core to import SystemClock from exactly this path, and says no Clock port will be introduced for now. So this dependency is a documented, deliberate decision, not an accident. The ADR does not change the blocking verdict.
